title: imc Module
content_markdown: This module offers support for instant message conference. It follows the architecture of IRC channels, you can send commands embedded in MESSAGE body, because there are no SIP UA clients which have GUI for IM conferencing.
overview: This module offers support for instant message conference. It follows the architecture of IRC channels, you can send commands embedded in MESSAGE body, because there are no SIP UA clients which have GUI for IM conferencing.
how_it_works:
You have to define an URI corresponding to im conferencing manager, where user can send commands to create a new conference room. Once the conference room is created, users can send commands directly to conferece's URI.

To ease the integration in the configuration file, the interpreter of the IMC commands are embeded in the module, from configuration poin of view, there is only one function which has to be executed for both messages and commands.

exported_parameters.name: rooms_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of the table storing IMC rooms.

exported_parameters.name: members_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of the table storing IMC members.

exported_parameters.name: hash_size
exported_parameters.description: The power of 2 to get the size of the hash table used for storing members and rooms.

exported_parameters.name: imc_cmd_start_char
exported_parameters.description: The character which indicates that the body of the message is a command.

exported_parameters.name: outbound_proxy
exported_parameters.description: The SIP address used as next hop when sending the message. Very useful when using OpenSIPS with a domain name not in DNS, or when using a separate OpenSIPS instance for imc processing. If not set, the message will be sent to the address in destination URI.

exported_functions.name: imc_manager
exported_functions.description: Handles Message method.It detects if the body of the message is a conference command.If so it executes it, otherwise it sends the message to all the members in the room.

examples.code:
...
# the rooms will be named chat-xyz to avoid overlapping
# with usernames
if(is_method("MESSAGE)
        && ($ru=~ "sip:chat-[0-9]+@" || ($ru=~ "sip:chat-manager@")
    imc_manager();
...
